name: SAP sales orders
description: Let agents find and read sales orders in SAP S/4HANA and set the customer's purchase order number on one.
identity: A technical (communication) user in SAP S/4HANA that may use the Sales Order API.

setup.title: Turn on the Sales Order API
setup.body: S/4HANA Cloud: set up the communication arrangement for sales order integration (SAP_COM_0109) with a communication user. S/4HANA on premise: ask your SAP Basis team to activate the OData service API_SALES_ORDER_SRV in SAP Gateway and give a technical user a role for it.
click: S/4HANA Cloud: Communication Systems > New: name it for this service, add an inbound communication user with a password
Communication Arrangements > New > scenario SAP_COM_0109 > choose that system and user > Save
On premise (SAP GUI): transaction /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE > Add Service > API_SALES_ORDER_SRV

setup.title: Limit what the user may change
setup.body: Give the user read access to sales orders, and change access only if agents may set purchase order numbers. Keep it to the sales organizations agents work in.

capabilities.label: Find and read sales orders
capabilities.description: List sales orders by sales organization, customer and date, and read one.

capabilities.label: Set purchase order numbers
capabilities.description: Change the customer's purchase order number on a sales order.

limits.label: Sales organizations
limits.help: Only orders of these sales organizations. Leave empty for all.

verify.label: SAP answers with the Sales Order API

revoke: Delete the communication arrangement (S/4HANA Cloud) or lock the technical user (on premise).

tools.name: sap_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders, newest first. Filter by sales organization, sold-to customer and creation date. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

created_from.description: Only orders created on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: sap_get_sales_order
tools.description: Read one sales order by its number.

tools.name: sap_set_customer_po
tools.description: Set the customer's purchase order number on a sales order.
